text_block_list.text:
Хиши Амадзон loses to Нарита Брайан at the
Arima
Kinen. The onlooking crowd
wonders if she can
ever outdo the Beast.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
However, she refuses to give up. She
vows to get
a proper rematch against
Нарита Брайан at the
Arima Kinen next
year.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After talking it over, we decide to set
the Osaka
Hai as our next goal, and it's
going to be first
place or bust!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
